''See also: [[Imperialist Guilds Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Imperialist [[Guilds]] are a coalition of organizations that serve as foundational pillars of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. This alliance includes the [[Magisters]], the [[Blackwatch]], the [[Imperial Guard]], and the Navigators. While they possess significant military strength—capable of rivaling any group except the [[Champions]]—they lack the economic resources held by the [[Independent Guilds]]. The Imperialist faction is characterized by its desire to maintain or restore imperial rule, specifically following the loss of the Emperor to an Elder attack. This political stance has led to accusations that they may have orchestrated the Emperor's death or are attempting to install a new, unsuited ruler. The [[Imperial Guard]], a key component of this group, is distinguished by its red-and-black uniforms and the use of alchemical [[Kameira enhancements]]. These processes replace body parts with supernatural elements, granting members unique powers and [[binding]] them to the [[Guild]]. The Imperialist [[Guilds]] have recently engaged in escalating conflicts and maneuvering for control, including launching attacks following the assassination of one of their members. Despite these internal tensions and the threat of empire-wide collapse, they remain a dominant force in the Capital and within the imperial hierarchy.}}
